list.title: Automations
list.emptyBody: Set one up yourself — a morning inbox summary, a reply draft for every customer email, a watch on competitor pricing.

automation.title: Automation
automation.deleteMessageApp: Godmode stops listening for “{{trigger}}” in {{app}}. Past runs and conversations stay in your history.
automation.deleteMessageWebhook: Its webhook URL stops working. Past runs and conversations stay in your history.
automation.deleteMessage: It won't run again. Past runs and conversations stay in your history.
automation.openRunChat: Opens the chat of this run
automation.changeTriggerOnComputer: Change the trigger in Godmode on your computer.
automation.enabledHint: Paused automations keep their settings but don't run.
automation.enabledHintEvents: Paused automations keep their settings and ignore new events.
automation.loginsFillOnly: Filled in, raw passwords stay hidden

empty.scheduleBody: Runs show up here when the schedule fires.
empty.conditionBody: Once a check finds the condition true, it shows up here.
empty.webhookBody: Call the webhook URL — or send a test event — and it shows up here.

edit.intro: When it happens, the agent gets to work — even while you're away.
edit.conditionPlaceholder: a competitor changes the price of their Pro plan (acme.com/pricing)
edit.conditionHint: In plain language. The agent checks it on the schedule below and gets to work once it's true.
edit.filterHint: In plain language. Events that don't match are skipped; leave empty to act on every event.
edit.keepOneChat: Every run continues the same chat, so it remembers previous runs.
edit.keepOneChatEvent: Every event continues the same chat. Off: each event gets its own chat, named after it.

problem.name: Name your automation
problem.prompt: Tell the agent what to do each time
problem.promptEvent: Tell the agent what to do with each event

promptPlaceholder.schedule: Collect last week's numbers from Stripe and Google Analytics, write a short report and send it to me.
promptPlaceholder.app: Save the invoice PDF to Drive and log sender, amount and due date in my Invoices sheet. The event details are passed along.
promptPlaceholder.condition: Compare their new plans with ours and update the pricing battlecard in Notion. What the check found is passed along.
promptPlaceholder.webhook: Check whether the order qualifies for a recovery offer and draft a friendly email. The request body is passed along.

filterPlaceholder.app: the sender is a customer, or the subject mentions an invoice

triggerHint.schedule: Every morning, each Monday, on the 1st…

notifyFooter.never: No notifications. A failing automation still shows under Needs you. Set up or changed on the phone, its runs fill in logins but never read raw passwords.
notifyFooter.always: A notification after every run, with what it did. Set up or changed on the phone, its runs fill in logins but never read raw passwords.
notifyFooter.failures: A failure is told once, until a run works again. Set up or changed on the phone, its runs fill in logins but never read raw passwords.
